_note: Grandstand guide seed content for marquee F1 circuits. Circuits are matched by name (must already exist). Consumed by scripts/seed-grandstands.ts. View ratings and pros/cons are curated editorial guidance, not official ratings.

Silverstone Circuit.name: Copse (Grandstand)
Silverstone Circuit.description: Overlooks the legendary Copse corner where cars turn in at over 180mph — one of the best spots to feel F1 speed.

Silverstone Circuit.name: Stowe (Grandstand)
Silverstone Circuit.description: A popular overtaking spot at the end of the Hangar Straight with good big-screen coverage.

Silverstone Circuit.name: Club (Grandstand)
Silverstone Circuit.description: Close to the pit exit and start/finish, great for the race start and strategy drama.

Circuit de Monaco.name: Grandstand K (Nouvelle Chicane)
pros: Cars braking hard from the tunnel
Circuit de Monaco.description: At the exit of the tunnel into the chicane — the only real passing place on the Monaco street circuit.

Circuit de Monaco.name: Grandstand T (Tabac)
Circuit de Monaco.description: Overlooks the Tabac corner and the harbourfront — pure Monaco spectacle.

Circuit de Monaco.name: Grandstand B (Sainte Dévote)
Circuit de Monaco.description: Overlooks the tight Sainte Dévote first corner where the start often decides the race.

Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps.name: Gold 3 (Eau Rouge / Raidillon)
Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps.bestFor: The most famous corner in F1
Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps.description: Overlooks the Eau Rouge–Raidillon complex, the corner every fan wants to see in person.

Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps.name: Grandstand 1 (La Source)
Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps.description: The tight La Source hairpin right after the start — a magnet for opening-lap overtakes.

Autodromo Nazionale di Monza.name: Grandstand 6A (Prima Variante)
pros: Biggest braking zone on the calendar
Autodromo Nazionale di Monza.description: Overlooks the first chicane at the end of the main straight — huge braking and regular passing.

Autodromo Nazionale di Monza.name: Grandstand 26 (Parabolica)
Autodromo Nazionale di Monza.description: The long Parabolica leading onto the start/finish straight — great for watching lines and slipstreams.

Circuit of the Americas.name: Turn 1 Grandstand
Circuit of the Americas.description: The steep uphill run to Turn 1 funnels the field into a spectacular braking zone.

Circuit of the Americas.name: Main Grandstand (Start/Finish)
Circuit of the Americas.description: Covered seating over the pit straight with pit-stop and podium views — a comfortable premium option.

Suzuka Circuit.name: Grandstand V2 (130R / Casio)
Suzuka Circuit.description: Covers the flat-out 130R and the final chicane, Suzuka's best overtaking spot.

Suzuka Circuit.name: Grandstand B (S Curves)
Suzuka Circuit.description: Overlooks the flowing S Curves where the best drivers make the difference.
